Tests legacy /users/bob redirect and webfinger endpoint, finds domain-matching bug, fixes and re-tests. Read-only endpoint checks, no authenticated post/fave/boost flow, no scope/persistence/CSP/header/idempotency verification.

Repeatedly runs seed script to catch SQL/init errors and py_compile for syntax — catches obvious breakage but this is debugging, not gate-mirroring verification; no time-compression, durability, or anti-cheat probing anywhere in the trajectory.

reasoning: The agent runs the server, exercises several main flows end-to-end (health, public timeline, seeded content, redirect, webfinger), confirms the pinned files download and (claims to) verify their SHA256, and catches/fixes obvious breakage — matching the level-5 anchor. It does not reach level 8: there is no verification of OAuth token issuance/scope enforcement, persistence across restart, CSP/security headers/cookie flags, pagination/idempotency/cache validators, UI palette/label/seed minima, anti-cheat conditions, or time-compression env vars, and no self-written tests mirroring the gates.
